title: The full cotangent complex of a localization vanishes
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $S\subseteq R$ a multiplicative subset, meaning $1\in S$ and $s,t\in S$ imply $st\in S$. Let $S^{-1}R$ be the ring of fractions $r/s$, with its canonical map $R\to S^{-1}R$. Then the standard cotangent complex $L_{S^{-1}R/R}$ of [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence] is a zero object in $D(S^{-1}R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; equivalently, $H^i(L_{S^{-1}R/R})=0$ for every integer $i$. No finite generation of $S$ and no finite presentation of $S^{-1}R$ over $R$ are assumed, and $0\in S$ is allowed.

proof.text: Put $B=S^{-1}R$. Choose the standard polynomial resolution $P_\bullet\to B$ of [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence]. Apply [lem-trf-localized-polynomial-resolution-model] with $T=B$: its fraction and coefficient identifications make $Q_\bullet=P_\bullet\otimes_R B$, augmented by $p\otimes b\mapsto\epsilon(p)b$, a polynomial resolution of $B$ over $B$. This applies without finiteness assumptions and includes $0\in S$.

source.place: Tag 08QP (lemma-flat-base-change), localized-resolution computation, with Tag 08QI (remark-resolution); exact localization: algebra.tex, Tag 00CS (proposition-localization-exact).

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-simplicial-differential-base-change] with $R'=T=B$ to this $P_\bullet$. It gives an isomorphism in $D(B)$ between $K=s(\Omega^1_{P_\bullet/R}\otimes_{P_\bullet}B)$ and $K'=s(\Omega^1_{Q_\bullet/B}\otimes_{Q_\bullet}B)$, induced by the specified inverse chain maps, commuting with all faces and degeneracies. By [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence], $K$ represents $L_{B/R}$ and, since Step 1 makes $Q$ a polynomial resolution, $K'$ represents $L_{B/B}$. Compose these comparisons to obtain $L_{B/R}\simeq L_{B/B}$.

source.place: Tag 08QZ (lemma-localize-at-bottom), displayed differential comparison; algebra.tex, Tag 00RV (lemma-differentials-base-change), with its universal-derivation formula.

proof.text: Use [lem-trf-constant-polynomial-resolution-retraction] with $A=B$ and $E=\varnothing$: the constant simplicial $B$-algebra $B$ is a polynomial resolution of $B$ over $B$, and its differential model is the alternating constant complex on $\Omega^1_{B/B}$. By [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], every $B$-derivation of $B$ kills every element, so the universal derivation is zero. Uniqueness in its universal property makes the identity and zero endomorphisms of $\Omega^1_{B/B}$ equal; hence this module is zero. This model is therefore termwise zero. Resolution comparison [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence] gives $L_{B/B}\simeq0$, and Step 2 gives $L_{B/R}\simeq0$.

source.place: Tag 08QH (lemma-cotangent-complex-polynomial-algebra), constant polynomial algebra model, and Tag 08QI (remark-resolution), augmented-complex criterion; empty-variable identity case.

proof.text: The cohomology functors of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] take the displayed isomorphism to $H^i(L_{B/R})\cong H^i(0)=0$ for every integer $i$. Conversely, if all these cohomology groups vanish, the map from its representing complex $K$ to the zero complex induces isomorphisms on every cohomology group, so is a quasi-isomorphism by that definition. Its image in the derived category is invertible, hence $L_{B/R}\simeq0$.

source.place: Tag 08R2 (lemma-when-zero), case (3); interpretation in derived.tex, Tag 05RU (definition-derived-category).
